text:
Ria M: RC hold — integration pipeline `ci/integration-staging` failing artifact download step (blob 404) on promote.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for run 2026-03-24T09:05Z. Failing checks: artifact-fetch. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/30012
Omar K: looks like the registry returned 404 for `redwood/app:rc-2026.03.24`. the image manifest was uploaded but a layer GET returned 404 intermittently.
Taylor H: Change window ends in ~45m. Options: 1) re-upload missing layer (if we can find it quickly) and re-run, 2) pin to previous rc image (fast), 3) abort and postpone cut.
Ria M: try re-upload + quick promote first. if we can't reconcile within 20m, pin and promote. we can't miss this window.
Omar K: attempting `registry inspect` and `blob upload` now. leaving a note in run. If registry auth is flaky, might be S3 multipart edge case.
deploy-bot: Manual artifact reupload requested by Omar K. Reupload started.
SRE_Oncall: I'm watching registry error rate. If we see >5% 5xxs I'll fallback to pin and alert infra.
Omar K: reupload finished; triggered manual promote. CI run 30013 queued.
deploy-bot: CI run 30013 artifact-fetch: 2/2 passed. Promotion allowed. :white_check_mark:
Ria M: cutting RC now. release notes: "RC 2026.03.24 0: temporary artifact reupload to address intermittent registry layer 404 during promote. Follow-up ticket #5903." Will attach repro steps.
Taylor H: creating ticket #5903 with registry logs, S3 request ids, and deploy-bot trace. We'll follow up with infra to harden blob proxy retries.
SRE_Oncall: setting a short-term alert for registry blob 404 spikes and increasing retry on the deploy-bot artifact fetch to 5 attempts for the next 24h.
Ria M: thanks all. promote complete and RC cut. If any canary fails, rollback plan ready
